description: This file defines the API for distributed tensor operations in PyTorch, including classes like DTensor, utility functions for distributing tensors and modules, and tensor factory functions such as ones, zeros, full, rand, randn, and empty. It handles tensor sharding, replication, redistribution, and module distribution across device meshes, integrating with autograd and supporting distributed training.
